# catalyst_nosql_tables (Data Source)

List existing NoSQL table identities. Requires ZohoCatalyst.nosql.READ. It does not read items or provision tables/indexes. Results are sorted lexicographically by ID. An empty project returns an empty list; denied access or malformed responses return an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" { type = string }

data "catalyst_nosql_tables" "existing" { project_id = var.project_id }

output "tables" { value = data.catalyst_nosql_tables.existing.tables }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID, written as a string.

### Read-Only

- `tables` (Attributes List) Existing infrastructure, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tables))

<a id="nestedatt--tables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tables`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Numeric ID represented as a string without loss of precision.
- `name` (String) Name reported by Catalyst.
